# VERDICT: Sea Time static home page (no scroll effect)

1. **Structure:** sticky slim navy header (logo, קורסים / יוון / המועדון / צור קשר, call button; menu button on phones) → full-bleed muted looping hero video of their boat with a poster fallback and a pause button, "שער הכניסה לעולם השייט", one subline, "תיאום הפלגת ניסיון" (tel:03-7260500) + "השוו בין הקורסים" → why Sea Time → three course cards (7 מטר / משיט 30 "הנמכר ביותר" / יוון) with the same seven facts from their comparison table, price and a CTA each (swipeable on phones, 3 columns on desktop) → משיט 30 as a five-step list → Greece band → club: founders, photo gallery, three real Google reviews → eight-question FAQ accordion from their pages → contact (phone, email, map link) → footer.
2. **How it differs from the scroll version:** normal scrolling only. No pinning, no scroll-scrubbed video, no rails, iris or chart redraw, and no scroll-craft engine. The JS is 60 lines with no framework: menu toggle, video play/pause, and one IntersectionObserver fade-in per block, which is turned off under prefers-reduced-motion (that also pauses the video and shows the poster). Fonts are Rubik + Assistant. All photos are their own WebP, lazy-loaded, and the video uses preload="metadata".
3. **Verified (Playwright + Chrome, 390×844, 360×640, 1440×900):** horizontal overflow 0, no console errors or failed requests, the video plays at every size, and every reveal fires. Nothing overlaps the header: it ends at y=64 and the hero copy starts at y=482 / 330 / 435. With reduced motion the video stays paused and all content is visible. The mobile menu opens.
4. **Detector (impeccable, static + in-browser):** I fixed 3 real findings: cyan-on-navy eyebrows were changed to muted text, cards had both a hairline border and a wide shadow and now use shadow only, and 12 near-identical font sizes were collapsed onto the type scale. The Greece panel is now solid, which fixed the static contrast flag. Three false positives remain. "Body text at viewport edge" is the off-screen cards in the swipe row. "Gradient text" comes from the detector's own injected script; it also fires on a blank page. "Cramped padding" appears only in static mode, because it cannot resolve CSS variables; the in-browser pass does not flag it.
5. **Facts:** every fact, price, quote and name comes from the 2026-10-22 crawl. משיט 30 is ₪7,000–9,200 with exam fees separate. No price is published for 7 מטר or Greece, so the page says how the price is set, with no number. The ~90% pass rate appears only as their own FAQ answer and is not shown as a stat.
6. **Open questions (TODO comments in index.html):** Is there a WhatsApp number? The site has none, so the page has no link. Is the משיט 30 age 18 or 17.5? The table says 18 and llms.txt says studying can start at 17.5; the page shows 18. Can a Greece price (and a 7 מטר price) be published? Where were the "Greece" photos taken? The caption stays neutral until that is confirmed.
